CITY OF PASADENA
  Finance Committee and City Council Meeting

D  June 3, 2019-2:30 P.M.
  City Hall Council Chamber

  SPECIAL JOINT MEETING

  OPENING:  Mayor Tornek called the special joint meeting of the Finance
  Committee and City Council to order at 2:45 p.m. (Absent:
  Councilmembers Madison, McAustin, Vice Mayor Hampton)

  ROLL CALL:
  Councilmembers:  Mayor Terry T ornek
  Vice Mayor Tyron Hampton
  Councilmember Victor Gordo
  Councilmember John J. Kennedy
  Councilmember Steve Madison
  Councilmember Gene Masuda
  . Councilmember Margaret McAustin
  Councilmember Andy Wilson

  Staff:  City Manager Steve Mermell
  City Clerk Mark Jomsky
  Lisa Hosey, Assistant City Attorney

  The Finance Committee and City Council reviewed and
  discussed the following agenda items:

  Councilmember Madison  CITY MANAGER'S RECOMMENDED FISCAL YEAR 2020
  arrived at 2:56 p.m.  OPERATING BUDGET AND FISCAL YEAR 2020 - 2024
  CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM BUDGET:
  Councilmember McAustin
  arrived at 2:59p.m.  Capital Improvement Program (CIP) and Operating Budget
  Presentations:
  Vice Mayor Hampton arrived
  at 4:35p.m.  •  Public Works

  For further details and information regarding the Budget
  discussions above, please see the approved Finance
  Committee minutes of June 3, 2019.

  Following discussion, on order of the Mayor, and consensus of
  the City Council, discussion on other department budgets may
  continue at the June 3, 2019 regular City Council meeting at 7:00
  p.m.
